description: Focused IT Glue REST API wrapper for MSP automation. The API follows the JSON:API media type and uses an x-api-key header. This spec covers the read surface used by existing read-only integrations plus the non-destructive write endpoints needed for contact sync, password mirroring, configuration creation, and onboarding documentation.

env_var_specs.name: ITGLUE_API_KEY
env_var_specs.description: IT Glue API key with permissions for the requested read and write operations.

tools.name: configurations_create
tools.description: Create a configuration. Required: data. Returns the new JsonApiResource.

tools.name: configurations_get
tools.description: Retrieve a configuration. Required: id. Returns the JsonApiResource.

tools.name: configurations_list
tools.description: Use stable fields such as organization id, name, hostname, serial number, or asset tag before creating records. Optional: filter[id], filter[name], filter[organization_id] (plus 6 more). Returns array of JsonApiResourceObject.

params.name: filter[name]
params.description: Exact match where supported by IT Glue.

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma separated sort fields; prefix with - for descending.

tools.name: configurations_update
tools.description: Update a configuration. Required: id, data. Returns the updated JsonApiResource.
